Today, even the statue of Gautam Buddha was swept away by the devastating floods. A symbol of peace, compassion, and hope carried away by the force of nature. 💔🌊 This is not just a statue being washed away. Behind every flood video is a family praying for safety, someone searching for their loved ones, and countless people watching everything they built disappear before their eyes. Fresh floods and landslides set off by heavy rain and storms have killed at least 14 people in Nepal and left another 11 missing, with authorities warning on Sunday that more flash floods were possible. The warnings covered 49 of Nepal's 77 districts, more than half of which faced a high risk of flooding, as water levels in major rivers kept rising. The video filmed at 5:30pm, local time, on Sunday, September 27 shows the latest destruction. It comes after a glacier collapsed near the border with China's Tibet Autonomous Region in late August, sending landslides and a flash flood through valleys downstream and killing more than 1,450 people. #ABCNews #Nepal #Landslide #Floods
